_real_world.variant_scope: T-AO-205 John Lewis class and T-AOE-6 Supply class fleet logistics ships (MSC civilian-crewed auxiliaries carry commercial-grade navigation radar, not a combat sensor suite).

_provenance.modeling_note: Reuses the repo's existing generic Civil_Navigation_Surface_Radar pattern as a distinct CSG-scoped record (rather than referencing the shared generic module directly) so the two CSG oiler/AOE records have their own sensor_ref under the csg/us subtree per the authoring standard's naming rule. No public sensor fit exists for the T-AO-205 or T-AOE-6 classes; range is the same radar-horizon engineering estimate as the repo's civilian navigation radar template (3.57*(sqrt(h1)+sqrt(h2)) km at 20 m antenna height vs a 5 m target), not a claimed instrumented maximum.

sensor.type.note: commercial navigation set is a radar; Radar is the only matching engine sensor type

sensor.max_range.note: copied from ships/modules/sensors/civil_navigation_surface_radar.json; radar-horizon engineering estimate (3.57*(sqrt(h1)+sqrt(h2)) km at 20 m antenna height vs a 5 m target), not an instrumented maximum

sensor.fov_deg.note: rotating commercial navigation radar gives full 360-deg coverage; copied from civil_navigation_surface_radar.json template

sensor.range_power.note: radar-equation exponent, standard engine default, copied from template

sensor.aspect_influence.note: 0.0 disables RCS aspect-angle modeling, copied from template

sensor.doppler_notch_width.note: 0.0: commercial nav radar has no MTI/doppler processing, copied from template

sensor.antenna_height_m.note: no public mast height for T-AO-205/T-AOE-6; copied unchanged from civil_navigation_surface_radar.json template

sensor.environment_domain.note: surface/maritime domain selected for a shipborne navigation radar per authoring standard
